title: Policy control, scheduled check and notice
goal: The owner can switch the automatic policy on and off, and a scheduled check announces an update with its apply time
acceptance: A `nerv` command and a dashboard switch enable or disable the automatic policy (today it can only be set through POST /api/update/policy)
Scheduler calls the existing evaluation; notice in Telegram and inbox with revision and time
"aspetta" / "wait" postpones to the next window; nothing runs unless the policy is enabled
privacy: Local only; tests use invented bases, revisions and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h, small fixes 0.5 h). Not a measurement.
